name: gitoversight
description: Govern private GitHub work through agent-scoped GitOversight policy while keeping public effects behind meaningful human review.

interface.shortDescription: Govern agent work on private GitHub repositories
interface.longDescription: Inspect authorized private repositories, prepare bounded changes, publish through policy, reconcile uncertain outcomes, and prepare public pre-PR reviews without sharing GitHub credentials.
defaultPrompt: List the private repositories this agent may access
Prepare and preview a bounded private change
Check or reconcile a GitOversight operation
